worldcombat.skill.electroball.summary: Charge your speed advantage over the target into an electric orb and hurl it: the greater the speed ratio, the bigger and brighter the orb and the harder it bursts. It is Gyro Ball's mirror — the same scale, now measuring your own speed and sending it far away. Aim at an enemy, or throw along any direction.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.0: A long-range cannon when you are faster than the target
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.1: Open fire from beyond the target's reach
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.2: Let the speed ratio grow the orb on screen
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.3: Throw along an empty direction to probe
worldcombat.skill.electroball.descriptio: The orb deals about %1$s special damage where it strikes; the damage is settled on the actual struck target's own speed ratio, so a fast user against a slow foe hits hardest. The launch appearance uses the expected target's %2$s load, and the contact burst recomputes the actual one. The target's Sp. Defence, type and crits settle on hit.

Thrown straight along the aim, it reaches up to %1$s blocks flying %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s-block orb radius; it bursts at the first block or first blocking non-ally and does not tunnel past it, and dissipates where it stops if it hits no one.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.overcharge: Overcharge form: power x1.12 and radius x1.2, but a heavier orb flying at x0.85 (easier to walk out of), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown.
Light form (default): it flies and casts faster at slightly lower power.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.growth.0: From level %1$s the orb power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.growth.1: From level %1$s the orb power rises to %2$s and the throw reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.preference: On: higher power and radius, but a heavier orb flying slower (easier to walk out of) with longer wind-up and cooldown. Off (default): light form, flying and casting fast and recovering cleanly at slightly lower power.
Only throw at a target within this range; closer in first beyond it. Large values suit a kiting companion, small ones wait for the target to close.
